cards.title: Allergic to Commitment
cards.body:
Calls it "going with the flow".
Panics at the word "plans."

cards.title: Lives for Drama
cards.body:
Needs a plot twist every week.
Will manufacture one if bored.

cards.title: Brunch Maximalist
cards.body:
Will order everything and "share".
Actually takes the best bites.

cards.title: Weekend Disappears
cards.body:
Goes off-grid every Friday.
Returns with a new hobby.

cards.title: Chronically Late
cards.body:
Time is a suggestion.
Arrives when the vibe is right.

cards.title: Too Honest
cards.body:
Will review the date out loud.
Offers bullet points.

cards.title: Soft Launch Specialist
cards.body:
Keeps things ambiguous for months.
Loves a mysterious caption.

cards.title: Sleep Talker
cards.body:
Spills secrets at 2 a.m.
Has receipts.

cards.title: Serial Hobbyist
cards.body:
Owns 14 starter kits.
Finished none.

cards.title: Dog-First
cards.body:
The dog chooses the date.
You are auditioning.

cards.title: Overachiever
cards.body:
Optimizes romance spreadsheets.
Has a KPI for feelings.

cards.title: Phone Minimalist
cards.body:
Texting is a chore.
Replies only to voice notes.

cards.title: ALL CAPS TEXTER
cards.body:
EMOTIONS AT MAX VOLUME.
EVERY MESSAGE IS URGENT.

cards.title: Workaholic
cards.body:
Calendar is fully booked.
Quality time requires scheduling.

cards.title: Night Noises (Snorer)
cards.body:
Sleeps like a chainsaw.
Wakes up refreshed anyway.

cards.title: Short Tempered
cards.body:
Fuse is decorative.
Apologies come later (maybe).

cards.title: Absent Minded
cards.body:
Loses keys daily.
Loves you deeply, forgets why they walked in.

cards.title: Broke
cards.body:
Date budget: vibes.
Splits everything—including fries.

cards.title: Durian Breath
cards.body:
Adventurous palate.
Regrettable aftertaste.

cards.title: Phone Addict
cards.body:
Thumbs move faster than feelings.
Screens over eye contact.

cards.title: No Close Friends
cards.body:
Says they’re “chill”.
You are their entire social calendar.

cards.title: Extrovert
cards.body:
Refuels in crowds.
Invites strangers to brunch.

cards.title: Introvert
cards.body:
Refuels in silence.
Cancels plans to recharge.

cards.title: Wants to Settle Down (Homebody)
cards.body:
Dream date: couch + snacks.
Peak travel is a new coffee shop.

cards.title: Can’t Settle Down (Nomad)
cards.body:
Always between places.
Commitment requires a forwarding address.

cards.title: Can’t Talk About Feelings
cards.body:
Emotions stay in drafts.
Changes the subject on “how are we?”

cards.title: Must Talk About Feelings (All the Time)
cards.body:
Wants check-ins every hour.
Processes everything immediately.

cards.title: Must Cuddle All Night
cards.body:
Octopus mode: enabled.
Personal space is optional.

cards.title: Allergic to Touching
cards.body:
High-five only.
Hugs require consent forms.

cards.title: Intermittent Hygiene
cards.body:
Sometimes minty fresh.
Sometimes… vibes only.

cards.title: Must Sleep in Separate Beds
cards.body:
Two blankets, two beds.
Love you from over there.

cards.title: Wears Athleisure All the Time
cards.body:
Dress code: stretchy.
Ready for brunch or a jog (but mostly brunch).

cards.title: Wears Wife Beater at Home
cards.body:
Comfort: questionable.
Thinks it’s a classic.

cards.title: Wears Onesie at Home
cards.body:
Cozy chaos.
Will answer the door like this.

cards.title: Jealous of Your Pets
cards.body: Thinks your cat is flirting with you.

cards.title: Competitive About Everything
cards.body: Winning is their love language.

cards.title: Never Apologizes
cards.body: Will “explain” instead of apologize.

cards.title: Therapy Talk in Every Argument
cards.body: Diagnoses you mid-fight.

cards.title: "Just One More Drink" Person
cards.body: Always “fine”—until tomorrow.

cards.title: Food Allergy Collector
cards.body: Dinner plans require a spreadsheet.

cards.title: Loud Chewer
cards.body: ASMR, but cursed.

cards.title: Needs Constant Reassurance
cards.body: Needs affirmations on a schedule.

cards.title: Doesn’t Tip (or Tips Badly)
cards.body: Debates gratuity like it’s philosophy.

cards.title: Messages in Voice Messages Only
cards.body:
Won’t type it.
Will monologue it.

cards.title: Pleaser
cards.body:
Boundary-free, conflict-avoidant.
Smiles through pain.

cards.title: Sensitive New Age Guy (Orgasm KPI)
cards.body:
Treats intimacy like a performance review.
Needs a gold star.

cards.title: Secret Love Weapon (You’ll Never Get to See)
cards.body:
Promises magic.
Delivers mystery.

cards.title: Hall Monitor Energy
cards.body:
Corrects your grammar.
Corrects your joy.

cards.title: Emoji Overuser
cards.body: Sends 🔥💯✨ instead of feelings.

cards.title: Never Asks Questions
cards.body:
Says yes to everything.
Resents it later.

cards.title: Chronically Unreachable
cards.body:
Takes 3 business days to reply.
Calls it being ‘busy’.
